description:
You are a fitness instructor setting up for a virtual class in Jitsi Meet. The meeting "VirtualHIITClass" is already open. You need to configure two specific settings:

1. Enable "Noise suppression" to filter out background gym noise.
2. Hide your "Self View" (the small preview of your own camera) to focus on participants.

Save two pieces of evidence:
- Take a screenshot showing the Noise Suppression setting enabled and save it to `/tmp/noise_suppression_evidence.png`.
- Take a screenshot of the final meeting view (with self-view hidden) and save it to `/tmp/av_config_final.png`.

Note: You may need to look in the overflow menu (three dots) or Audio/Video settings to find these options.
